stem.text: A resultant force of $10\,\text{N}$ acts on a body for a time of $2.0\,\text{s}$.
Which graph could show the variation with time $t$ of the momentum $p$ of the body?

stem.alt: Graph of p/kg m s-1 on the vertical axis against t/s on the horizontal axis, with four straight lines labelled A, B, C and D, all ending at t = 2.0 s.
